question: The volume (in m³) of a cube, each of whose edges is 42 m, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **edge** of the **cube** (a) = 42 m.

**Volume** = a³ = 42 × 42 × 42.

Unit digit check: 2 × 2 × 2 = 8. The answer must end in 8.

Checking options, only 74,088 ends with 8.

**∴ The correct answer is 74,088 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Edge** of the **cube** (a) = 42 m

**Formula Used:**

**Volume of a cube** = (Side)³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5231b303622ac6f8cca38c29108143ad593b3daacd0ba1aaed86150535202538.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = 42³

⇒ Volume = 42 × 42 × 42

⇒ Volume = 1,764 × 42

⇒ Volume = 74,088 m³

**∴ The correct answer is 74,088 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of a Cube

The **Total Surface Area** (TSA) of a cube is 6a² and the **Lateral Surface Area** (LSA) is 4a².

Diagonal of a Cube

The length of the **longest diagonal** that can fit inside a cube is given by a√3.

Units of Volume

Volume is always expressed in **cubic units** (m³, cm³, etc.) as it involves three dimensions of length.</p
